name: llama.cpp CUDA on Tesla V100 (PCIe 32GB): Llama-2-7B Q4_0 FA-on pp512 prefill tok/s (scoreboard #15013)
methodology: COMMUNITY-SCOREBOARD (llama.cpp discussion #15013, maintainer-curated). llama-bench -m llama-2-7b.Q4_0.gguf -ngl 99 -fa 1. Build commit 51f5a45, reporter @Hedede. llama-bench default -r 5 repeats, mean +/- std. Single-GPU per thread rules. Per-request batch-1, NOT aggregate. Hardware row: 32 GB / HBM2 / 4096 bit.
notes: Maintainer-verified scoreboard row from ggml-org/llama.cpp#15013. Identical model/test/flags across every GPU makes this the cleanest cross-GPU llama.cpp comparison in the repo. tg128 is bandwidth-bound; pp512 tracks compute.
